title: Vanilla+
description: Introducing... Vanilla+! This modpack enhances the vanilla minecraft experience by adding shader support, better ui, some QOL mods, and most importantly... OPTIMIZATION! On a laptop with NO GRAPHICS CARD I was able to get 60 fps WITH SHADERS using this.
body:
Introducing the vanilla+ modpack! This modpack does a few things for you:

QOL: This modpack features QOL mods such as Xaeros minimap, appleskin, EssentialMod, and more! Play with a better experience for everyone.

OPTIMIZATION: Vanilla+ has many mods to optimize the game to run at max efficiency. To prove, let me just tell you I got 60 fps on a laptop that literally has no graphics card... with shaders.

SHADERS AND TEXTURE PACK SUPPORT: Features some of my favourite texture packs that clean up the UI, as well as shader support!

VANILLA FUNCTIONALITY: This modpack doesn't change the game by adding stuff in any way! Use this modpack to enhance your experience in vanilla servers, or singleplayer survival!

MODS FOR CREATIVE: Worldedit and Axiom are both included, providing a better creative experience for all.
